result_text:
The landscape contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer cut off at `contributorsListLimit`. The `reports` module compiles and its tests pass (`mvn -q -o -pl reports test`). I did not generate a landscape report to inspect the HTML.

Changes, all in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on the contributor table stream and the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. The sort order is unchanged. Every contributor gets a row, and the same method serves the all-contributors, recent, bots and teams tables.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` on the recently-active bar chart stream, so there is one bar per recently active contributor.

The setting stays in `LandscapeConfiguration` and is now unused by these two code paths. Nothing else reads it in the landscape report.

I did not touch `ContributorsReportGenerator.java:252`, which hard-codes a 500-item cap. It is in the single-project contributors report, not the landscape one. Say if you want that one removed too.

I did not commit.
